title: Greenzo Energy Secures ₹2.51 Billion to Expand Electrolyzer Manufacturing
summary: Clean energy technology and manufacturing company Greenzo Energy India has secured ₹2.51 billion (~$26.48 million) cumulatively across three investment rounds, led by private and institutional investors. The company plans to deploy the fresh capital to expand its electrolyzer manufacturing capacity, strengthen backward integration, advance research and development, support working capital requirements, and accelerate project execution across domestic and international markets.
